name: glitch-type
title: Glitch Type
description: Burst-based glitching, not a permanent loop: on an interval the text fires a 3-frame RGB channel split with clip-path slicing, then rests clean — the disturbance reads as an event, not wallpaper.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Industrial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Cut
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Interval Burst: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
